name: Coding Club
description: A student community for learning programming, web development, software engineering, and problem solving.
longDescription: This Coding Club brings students together to practice programming, build projects, participate in coding challenges, and share software development knowledge.

name: Environmental Club
description: Students working together to promote environmental awareness.
longDescription: This club organizes environmental awareness activities, campus cleanups, tree planting, and educational discussions about Lake Tana and sustainable living.

name: Debate Club
description: A discussion and public-speaking community where students develop communication and critical-thinking skills.
longDescription: Members participate in debates, public speaking sessions, presentations, and discussions on academic and community topics.

name: Creative Arts Club
description: A creative community for students interested in art, photography, design, music, and creative expression.
longDescription: The Creative Arts Club gives students an opportunity to express themselves through visual arts, photography, music, design, and cultural activities.

name: Entrepreneurship Club
description: A student-led community focused on entrepreneurship, innovation, business ideas, and startups.
longDescription: Students can develop business ideas, learn about entrepreneurship, meet other innovators, and practice presenting ideas through pitch sessions.

name: Sports and Fitness Club
description: A community for students interested in sports, fitness, teamwork, and healthy lifestyles.
longDescription: The club organizes football, volleyball, running, fitness activities, and friendly competitions for students.
